Günde ne kadar çalışmalıyım?: How much should I study each day?
Bir sahne 5–10 dakika sürer. İlk kurulum: A scene lasts 5–10 minutes. During the initial setup, you choose your daily goal; the Today tab shows the next task for that day, so you don't have to think about what to study.
Yanlış cümle kurarsam ne olur?: What happens if I make a wrong sentence?
Mivo konuşmanı bölmeden doğru hâlini gös: Mivo shows you the correct version of your speech without interrupting and briefly explains why in your own language. The corrected sentences go to My Mistakes Notebook; you can review them whenever you want.
Konuşmanı yazıya çeviren sistemin kelime: We show the word-based confidence score of the system that converts your speech to text; low-scoring words are a hint for pronunciation. This is not a complete accent analysis. You can repeat the words you struggle with one by one in Pronunciation practice.
Konuşurken yazılı transkripti görebilir: Can I see the written transcript while speaking?
Evet. Söylediğin cümle önce ekranda görü: Yes. The sentence you say appears on the screen first; you can check and correct it before sending or re-recording. You also follow the other person's sentences in writing and by listening again.
A1’den B2’ye 21 sahne: havalimanı, otel,: 21 scenes from A1 to B2: airport, hotel, restaurant, taxi, doctor, job interview, flea market, house hunting, office break, and more. Each scene starts with a short video, then the Mivo character plays live.

Her oynayışta karşına farklı bir durum ç: Each time you play, a different situation arises: a mix-up, a finished product, a rushed person, a curious person, or a polite complaint. The scene goals remain the same, but the conversation goes differently. You collect 1–3 stars in each scene: finishing the video, playing live, and completing the goals with at most two corrections.
